150174.overview: Welcome to the island of Sonyc! In this intricate setting, one of the most exciting adventures ever created for the MSX standard will take place. Get ready to run at breakneck speed, defy the law of gravity with breathtaking jumps, explore frozen caves, explore a forest of giant trees, wander among tropical palm trees, fight fierce enemies, collect hundreds of rings and even search for treasure! All this and much, much more awaits you in SONYC.

424973.overview: 11 missions with different objectives. Earn money and upgrade your ship. 2 and 3 scroll planes with epic boss battles.

470339.overview: A One-on-one fighting game, sequel of South Town's Hero Turbo. Both games were programmed for the Turbo-R but they work fine on MSX2+

470340.overview: South Town's Hero ' Turbo is an Action game, developed and published by FM-Guamuom, which was released in Japan in 1995
